semiconductor_relevance: High — NIDEC ADVANCE TECHNOLOGY specializes in testing and inspection equipment for semiconductor packages and printed circuit boards.
summary: NIDEC ADVANCE TECHNOLOGY provides advanced testing solutions that evaluate wire conductivity and inspect for open/leak circuits on printed circuit boards and semiconductor packages. Their technologies are crucial for ensuring the reliability of electronic components and final products in high-performance applications.
capabilities: Grid Array Testing System (GATS) for open/leak circuit tests
Automated Optical Inspection Equipment for locating circuit issues
Inspection systems for touch screen panels and LCDs

regional_presence.Taiwan: NIDEC ADVANCE TECHNOLOGY is established in Taiwan, focusing on the semiconductor testing market.
